ACLED Pull
```{r, cache=TRUE}
#API website
base_url <- "https://acleddata.com/api/acled/read"
token <- read_file("access_token.txt") #if you want to recreate, map to your access token

#API pull from ACLED
resp <- GET(url = base_url,
            query = list(`_format` = "csv",
                         country = "Nigeria",
                         event_date = "2019-01-01|2021-12-31",
                         event_date_where = "BETWEEN",
                         limit = 0),
            add_headers(Authorization = paste("Bearer", token))
            )

stop_for_status(resp)


#Formatting into csv
csv_txt <- content(resp, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
ng_acled <- read_csv(csv_txt, show_col_types = FALSE)

ng_acled <- ng_acled|>
  mutate(event_date=as.character(event_date))

#writing the scraped data into a SQL db
con <- dbConnect(SQLite(), "../data/ng_acled.db")
dbWriteTable(con, "ng_acled.db", ng_acled, overwrite = TRUE)
dbDisconnect(con)

```



News Scraper Set up
```{r, cache = TRUE}
#setting some parameters
query <- "boko haram"
max_pages <- 20

trim <- function(x) sub("/+$", "", x)

#creating a function to report if the scraper runs into any timeout/cloudfare issues
grab_html <- function(url) {
  resp <- try(
    GET(url, user_agent("rvest project scraper"), timeout(20)),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  if (inherits(resp, "try-error") || status_code(resp) != 200) return(NULL)
  page <- try(read_html(resp), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(page, "try-error")) return(NULL)
  page
}

#the key part that is extracting boko haram related links from the searched pages
extract_article_links <- function(page) {
  if (is.null(page)) return(character(0))
  page |>
    html_elements("h2 a, h3 a, .entry-title a, .post-title a") |>
    html_attr("href") |>
    na.omit() |>
    unique()
}
```


Informant24/7 Link Grabber
```{r, cache = TRUE}
#specific code that sets up the link grabber for the Informant24/7 source
get_informant_results <- function(query, max_pages = 20) {
  base <- "https://theinformant247.com"
  links_all <- character(0)

  for (p in 1:max_pages) {
    q <- URLencode(query, reserved = TRUE)
    url <- paste0(
      trim(base),
      "/?s=", q,
      if (p > 1) paste0("&paged=", p) else ""
    )
    message("Pulling links from: ", url)
    page <- grab_html(url)
    links <- extract_article_links(page)
    if (length(links) == 0) break
    links_all <- union(links_all, links)
  }
  tibble(
    source = base,
    article_url = links_all
  )
}
```


MegaNews Link Grabber
```{r, cache = TRUE}
#specific code that sets up the link grabber for the MegaNews source

get_meganews_results <- function() {
  base_tag <- "https://meganews.com.ng/tag/boko-haram"
  links_all <- character(0)

  for (p in 1:max_pages) {
    url <- if (p == 1) {
      paste0(base_tag, "/")
    } else {
      paste0(base_tag, "/page/", p, "/")
    }
    message("Pulling links from: ", url)
    page <- grab_html(url)
    links <- extract_article_links(page)
    if (length(links) == 0) break
    links_all <- union(links_all, links)
  }
  tibble(
    source = "https://meganews.com.ng",
    article_url = links_all
  )
}
```


NewsHunter Link Grabber
```{r, cache = TRUE}
#specific code that sets up the link grabber for the NewsHunter source

get_newshunter_results <- function() {
  tag_urls <- c(
    "https://thenewshunterblog.wordpress.com/tag/boko-haram/",
    "https://thenewshunterblog.wordpress.com/tag/boko-haram-2/"
  )
  map_dfr(tag_urls, function(u) {
    message("Pulling links from: ", u)
    page <- grab_html(u)
    links <- extract_article_links(page)
    tibble(
      source = "https://thenewshunterblog.wordpress.com",
      article_url = links
    )
  }) |>
    distinct()
}
```


Link Scraper Set-up
```{r, cache = TRUE}

#this function is setting up the scraper for the three news sources
scrape_article <- function(url, source) {
  message("Scraping article: ", url)

  page <- grab_html(url)
  if (is.null(page)) {
    return(tibble(
      source = source,
      url = url,
      title = NA_character_,
      pub_date_raw = NA_character_,
      text = NA_character_
    ))
  }
  title <- NA_character_
  pub_date_raw <- NA_character_
  text <- NA_character_

  #set up for scraping the informant24/7 links
  if (grepl("theinformant247.com", source, fixed = TRUE)) {
    title_node <- html_element(page, "h1, .entry-title")
    if (length(title_node) > 0) title <- html_text2(title_node)
    date_node <- html_element(page, "time, .entry-date, .post-date, .post-meta time")
    if (length(date_node) > 0) pub_date_raw <- html_text2(date_node)
    body_nodes <- html_elements(page, "article p, .entry-content p, .post-content p, .post p")
    if (length(body_nodes) > 0) {
      text <- body_nodes |>
        html_text2() |>
        paste(collapse = "\n")
    }
    
  #set up for scraping the meganews links
  } else if (grepl("meganews.com.ng", source, fixed = TRUE)) {
    title_node <- html_element(page, ".td-post-title .entry-title")
    if (length(title_node) > 0) title <- html_text2(title_node)
    date_node <- html_element(page, ".td-module-date")
    if (length(date_node) > 0) pub_date_raw <- html_text2(date_node)
    body_nodes <- html_elements(page, "article p, .entry-content p, .post-content p, .post p")
    if (length(body_nodes) > 0) {
      text <- body_nodes |>
        html_text2() |>
        paste(collapse = "\n")
    }

  #set up for scraping the newshunter links
  } else if (grepl("thenewshunterblog.wordpress.com", source, fixed = TRUE)) {
    title_node <- html_element(page, "h1, .entry-title")
    if (length(title_node) > 0) title <- html_text2(title_node)
    date_node <- html_element(page, ".post-meta-date a")
    if (length(date_node) > 0) pub_date_raw <- html_text2(date_node)
    body_nodes <- html_elements(page, ".post-content > p")
    if (length(body_nodes) > 0) {
      text <- body_nodes |>
        html_text2() |>
        paste(collapse = "\n")
    }

  } else {
    title_node <- html_element(page, "h1, .entry-title")
    if (length(title_node) > 0) title <- html_text2(title_node)
    date_node <- html_element(page, "time, .entry-date, .post-date, .post-meta time")
    if (length(date_node) > 0) pub_date_raw <- html_text2(date_node)
    body_nodes <- html_elements(page, "article p, .entry-content p, .post-content p, .post p")
    if (length(body_nodes) > 0) {
      text <- body_nodes |>
        html_text2() |>
        paste(collapse = "\n")
    }
  }
#formatting tibble
  tibble(
    source = source,
    url = url,
    title = title,
    pub_date_raw = pub_date_raw,
    text = text
  )
}
```


Running Scraping function
```{r, cache = TRUE}
results_informant   <- get_informant_results(query, max_pages) #scraping informant for links
results_meganews    <- get_meganews_results() #scraping meganews for links
results_newshunter  <- get_newshunter_results() #scraping newshunter for links

search_results <- bind_rows( #binding all the links together
  results_informant,
  results_meganews,
  results_newshunter
) |>
  distinct()

article_data <- pmap_dfr( #scraping all of the links using the function from last section
  list(
    url    = search_results$article_url,
    source = search_results$source
  ),
  ~ scrape_article(..1, ..2)
)

article_data |> #quickview of the result
  select(source, title, pub_date_raw) |>
  head()


#writing the scraped data into a SQL db
con <- dbConnect(SQLite(), "nigeria_news.db")
dbWriteTable(con, "nigeria_news", article_data, overwrite = TRUE)
dbDisconnect(con)

```
